scope: Complete40-step native RGB64 actor wrappers at TILE8 with fused Adam; packing/validation/copyback included, restore/reference/parity checks and clocks queries excluded from timing.
method: Wait for500ms of process-monitor quiet; alternate baseline/replica order; restore identical resumed checkpoint before each timed update; sample compute processes every100ms and explicitly at pair boundaries; reject any contaminated pair.
monitor_limit: Process-presence samples do not prove absence between samples. Known desktop services are listed and excluded; every other external CUDA process invalidates a pair.

baseline_t8.scope: Actor W/G/Adam shared during all steps; rollout/mailboxes global; separate critic phase

replicated_t8.scope: Actor W/G/Adam shared during all steps; rollout/mailboxes global; separate critic phase
